Great support tower for slowing down hordes. |tooltip-2 = Capable of detecting [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] enemies. }} {{QuoteContainer| |-|Current = {{QuoteBox|Chill and freezes hordes of enemies in a wave of frost.|Store Description}} |-|Original = {{QuoteBox|Burn multiple enemies at once and chip away defense.|Former Store Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Cryomancer''' is an exclusive support [[Towers|tower]] which attacks enemies with a frost beam. It could have been obtained by triumphing [[Krampus Frosthold]]. It could have also been obtained via a gamepass for {{Robux|500}} during the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. Most recently, the '''Cryomancer''' was put on sale in December of 2024, costing {{Robux|699}} to purchase. The '''Cryomancer''' fires a frost beam which applies the chillness slowness effect to enemies every hit, which stacks up to its maximum slowdown. This beam can only hit three enemies every tick at Level 0–3, increasing to six at Level 4. At Level 4, when the enemy's slowdown is higher than max slowdown, the enemy will freeze. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen or slowed down. It also has a limited amount of ammo, which means that when it runs out of its ammo, it will have to reload. It only reloads when it runs out of ammo. At Level 2+, its freezing effects will deal tick damage every second. It can also damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies from Level 0, though due to it not having any damage at Level 0, in reality it cannot damage them until Level 2. It cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] or [[Flying]] enemies. The '''Cryomancer''' will melt 5% defense every tick, increasing the value it decrease it by with upgrades. It can only melt an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. As this tower's damage is quite weak meaning it can only be used to clear out earlier waves, this tower is mostly considered a support tower. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = }} ==Skins== ''To see all the upgrades of a skin, see the [[/Gallery#Skin Upgrades|gallery]] page.'' {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:Krampus_Slayer_Cryomancer_Icon.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Krampus|Krampus Slayer}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Event}} |- !Daily Store Cost |N/A |- !Obtained From |[[Krampus' Revenge Event#Gifts|Gift of Agony]] |} ==Strategy== *This tower should not be used as early-game defense, as it deals no damage until Level 2. **At Level 2, the '''Cryomancer''' can fend off against weaker enemies like the [[Normal]] or [[Abnormal]], though while it can deal some damage to stronger ones like the [[Normal Boss]], its low DPS will make killing it very long. ***Because of this, the '''Cryomancer''' should be used mostly as a support tower alongside other towers. *Multiple '''Cryomancers''' can be quite effective at slowing down hordes of enemies. **Do note that enemies with the [[Freeze Immunity]] cannot be slowed down or frozen by the '''Cryomancer'''. Larger enemies are also frozen for a shorter amount of time than average-sized enemies. **Bosses are immune to being frozen by default. However, they are only partially immune to being slowed down by its chillness effect, as it is only weaker on them. Due to this, the '''Cryomancer''' can be very useful for slowing down major bosses such as the [[Fallen King]]. *The '''Cryomancer''' can be useful for decreasing an enemy's defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **It is especially useful as it can melt defense from Level 0, being the cheapest form of defense melting in the game. **However, do note that as the defense melting happens when an enemy is frozen or slowed down, freeze immune enemies cannot have their defense reduced. **The defense melt can stack with other towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]], allowing you to remove an enemy's defense entirely. ***However, the '''Cryomancer's''' defense melt does not stack with [[Frost Blaster]]'s and [[Freezer]]'s defense melt. *The '''Cryomancer''' can be quite useful at clumping up enemies, allowing towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] to hit more enemies with their explosions. *The '''Cryomancer''' has lead detection from Level 0, allowing it to deal damage to lead enemies when it is upgraded to at least Level 2. **However, it does not have hidden detection, only being able to hit these enemies when they are caught in its frost beam. ***You can use outside means, such as the [[Firework Technician]] or the [[UAV]], to remedy this. **The '''Cryomancer''' cannot damage [[Flying]] enemies without flying detection, even if they are caught in the hitbox of the '''Cryomancer'''. ==Trivia== *Due to a bug, the '''Cryomancer's''' inventory description used to be the same as the [[Pyromancer]]'s. *The Level 4 upgrade name, ''Winter's Fury'', is a reference to an upgraded version of the [[w:c:callofduty:Winter's Howl|Winter's Howl]] from ''Call of Duty: Zombies''. **The Level 2 upgrade price is also a reference to [[w:c:callofduty:Group 935|Group 935]]. *The '''Cryomancer''' used to be able to affect units, which made it the only way to decrease the defense of units. ==Update History== ''For
